name: projectile
describe: A ball is thrown from the ground at an angle and follows a curved path, rising, slowing at the top and falling back to the ground, with its path left behind as a faint trail.

name: pendulum
describe: A pendulum bob hangs from a fixed point on a string and swings from left to right and back, the angle shrinking a little each swing.

name: sine_circle
describe: A point goes once round a circle on the left while its height is traced to the right as a growing sine wave.

name: square_numbers
describe: First one block appears, then a row and a column of blocks are added to make a 2 by 2 square, then another row and column make a 3 by 3 square.

name: fraction_bar
describe: A bar is cut into four equal parts and three of the parts fill with colour one after another, with the label 3/4 under the bar.

name: orbit
describe: The Earth moves round the Sun on a circular orbit while the Moon goes round the Earth on a small circle.

name: water_cycle
describe: First water rises as vapour from the sea, then it gathers into a cloud, then rain falls from the cloud back onto the land and the sea.

name: number_line_jumps
describe: On a number line from 0 to 10 a frog starts at 2 and makes three jumps of 2, landing on 4, 6 and 8.
